messages:
sara: FYI — Kestrel POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Need final scope + success criteria.
aj: Can we confirm data access? They said S3 + sample DB. Any constraints?
kestrel-poc-lead: yes, 10GB sample data in a shared S3 prefix; no PII. We'll provide read-only creds and a security questionnaire.
maya: Good. SE question: what are the primary use cases — canned response generation or summarization?
kestrel-poc-lead: Main is triage + canned-response generation for support agents. Secondary is weekly digest summarization for product.
dylan: On pricing — will they start hosted or want a dedicated quote? They earlier asked for a committed capacity estimate.
sara: They're starting hosted (trial) but want a cost estimate if we scale to dedicated at 10k msgs/day. Need per-token baseline + committed discount tiers.
aj: For success criteria I propose: latency < 300ms p50, quality: F1 > 0.8 on entity extraction eval, ops: stable at 2k concurrent users for 48h. Thoughts?
maya: Looks good. Add security: zero PII leakage in 10000 randomized prompts as a pass/fail metric.
kestrel-poc-lead: Agree. Timeline: 2-week POC — week1 ingest + prompts/setup, week2 stress tests + evals. Is that feasible?
dylan: Feasible. SE runbook needed for data onboarding and a prompt suite. I'll upload the prompt set to the shared drive after the call.
aj: Prompt examples to start the eval harness:
```
1) "Summarize the support ticket and suggest next action"
2) "Extract customer_name, product, issue_type (json)"
3) "Rewrite the agent reply to be concise and empathetic"
```
We'll run automated evals on ~200 held-out cases.
sec-bot: New security questionnaire submitted by kestrel. Link: https://sec.redwood.example/sq/19765
maya: I'll take the SQ items for network and data encryption. @sara can you own legal/compliance Qs?
sara: Yep, I'll coordinate with legal. Also need finance to provide provisional committed capacity quote by EOD Thursday.
kestrel-poc-lead: Thursday quote works. Any onboarding blockers? We'll need role-based creds and an IP allowlist for our staging VPC.
aj: We'll prepare an onboarding doc and an IP allowlist template and share before the call.
dylan: Potential blocker: model-variant fallback. Confirm they accept 8-bit quantized model for the cost path. @kestrel-poc-lead?
kestrel-poc-lead: Acceptable provided outputs match their golden set >= 95% similarity on key metrics.
maya: I'll add that to the success criteria. Can we lock the final success criteria and agenda in this thread before 9am PT tomorrow? :thumbsup:
sara: Agreed. I'll post the agenda + dial-in 30m before the meeting. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
